trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for TELECOM.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- network_complaint: Diagnose coverage and speed complaints against live network status and raise a field ticket where warranted.
- recharge_and_plan: Recharge a prepaid number, migrate a plan and explain validity and benefits from the live catalogue.

Business context:
- network_complaint: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.
- recharge_and_plan: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [network_complaint]
  - Known outage first: Where a known outage covers the area, the tool's ETA is quoted and no duplicate ticket is raised.
  - Diagnose before ticket: A line diagnostic must run before a ticket is raised, so the category is evidenced.
  - No coverage promises: The agent must not promise coverage improvement beyond the ticket's stated window.
  - Handset limits: Where the diagnostic reports the handset unsupported, that is stated rather than blamed on the network.
  [recharge_and_plan]
  - Catalogue truth: Only plans returned by list_plans may be offered, with the price and validity the tool returns.
  - Postpaid cycle: A postpaid plan change takes effect from the next billing cycle, never immediately.
  - No benefit invention: Bundled benefits may only be described where the plan record carries them.
  - Balance before recharge: Existing balance and validity must be read before a recharge is recommended.

Tools available to you (7): apply_recharge, check_network_status, list_plans, lookup_subscriber, raise_network_ticket, run_line_diagnostic, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: te-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: apply_recharge
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a recharge or plan migration to the subscriber.

model_visible_tools.name: check_network_status
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve tower status, known outages and congestion for a location.

model_visible_tools.name: list_plans
model_visible_tools.description: List plans available to this subscriber with price, validity and data.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_subscriber
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve plan, balance, validity, data left and billing cycle position. Read before any recharge is recommended.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_network_ticket
model_visible_tools.description: Raise a field ticket with a resolution window.

model_visible_tools.name: run_line_diagnostic
model_visible_tools.description: Run a remote diagnostic on the subscriber's connection.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.

steps.purpose: Report slow data issue.
steps.text: నమస్కారం, నా data చాలా slow గా ఉంది.
steps.clean_text: నమస్కారం, నా data చాలా slow గా ఉంది.
steps.model_visible_text: నమస్కారం, నా tata చాలా slow గా ఉంది.

steps.purpose: Ask for identity verification factors.
steps.expected_behavior: Prompt for verification before discussing account details.
steps.text: నమస్కారం. మీ internet speed సమస్యను నేను పరిష్కరిస్తాను. ముందుగా, verification కోసం మీ mobile number మరియు pincode చెప్పగలరా?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must verify the caller's identity before accessing network status or diagnostic tools for their specific account.

steps.purpose: Provide MSISDN and pincode.
Clarify the corrupted pincode.
steps.expected_behavior: Confirm the pincode since it might be misheard and is critical for network check.
steps.text: ధన్యవాదాలు. మీ pincode 560009 అని చెప్పారు, అవునా?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent confirms the pincode because it is a critical parameter for checking network status and verifying identity.

steps.purpose: Correct the pincode.
Acknowledge correction and initiate verification.
steps.expected_behavior: Acknowledge the correct pincode and proceed to verify identity.
steps.text: క్షమించండి. నేను మీ వివరాలను verify చేస్తాను, దయచేసి line లో ఉండండి.
steps.planner_rationale: With the correct MSISDN and pincode, the agent can now run the identity verification tool.

steps.purpose: Verify customer identity.
Return verification outcome.
Inform user that verification is complete and network check is starting.
steps.expected_behavior: Acknowledge successful verification and state the next action.
steps.text: మీ details verify అయ్యాయి. నేను ఇప్పుడు 560001 ప్రాంతంలో network status check చేస్తాను.
steps.planner_rationale: Identity is verified, so the agent can now safely proceed to check the network status for the user's location.

steps.purpose: Check network status for the provided pincode.
Return network status.
Relay the network status to the user.
steps.expected_behavior: State exactly what the tool returned without adding unverified claims.
steps.text: నేను check చేశాను, 560001 లో ఎటువంటి outage లేదా known issue లేదు. Network status పూర్తిగా normal గా ఉంది.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent grounds the response in the tool output, confirming no outage exists.

steps.purpose: Challenge the normal network status.
steps.text: మీరు ఎలా చెప్తారు normal అని? నేను చాలా slow speed face చేస్తున్నాను. Reason ఏంటి?
steps.clean_text: మీరు ఎలా చెప్తారు normal అని? నేను చాలా slow speed face చేస్తున్నాను. Reason ఏంటి?
steps.model_visible_text: మీరు ఎలా చెప్తారు normal అని? నేను చాలా slow speed face చేస్తున్నాను. Reason ఏంటి?

steps.purpose: Propose running a line diagnostic to find the root cause.
steps.expected_behavior: Offer to run a diagnostic when the network status is normal but the user still faces issues.
steps.text: మీకు కలుగుతున్న ఇబ్బందికి క్షమించండి. ఖచ్చితమైన కారణం తెలుసుకోవడానికి, నేను మీ connection పైన ఒక line diagnostic run చేస్తాను.
steps.planner_rationale: Following BR_NET_02, a line diagnostic must be run to evidence the category of the issue before any ticket can be considered.

steps.purpose: Run a remote line diagnostic.
Return diagnostic results.
Inform the user of the diagnostic results.
steps.expected_behavior: State the exact signal strength and handset support status from the tool.
steps.text: Diagnostic పూర్తయింది. మీ signal strength -85 dBm తో బాగానే ఉంది, కానీ మీ handset మా network కు support చేయడం లేదని report వచ్చింది.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent strictly relays the diagnostic tool's findings, specifically mentioning the handset is unsupported as per BR_NET_04.

steps.purpose: Question the unsupported handset claim.
steps.text: నాది 4G phone. Support చేయకపోవడం ఏంటి? నాకు clear గా explain చేయండి.

steps.purpose: Reiterate the tool's finding and refuse to promise improvements.
steps.expected_behavior: Refuse to promise better coverage or speed, adhering to BR_NET_03 and BR_NET_04.
steps.text: నేను అర్థం చేసుకోగలను. కానీ system లో run చేసిన diagnostic ప్రకారం, మీ ప్రస్తుత phone మా high-speed network కు అనుకూలంగా లేదు. దీనివల్ల నేను మీకు speed పెరుగుతుందని guarantee ఇవ్వలేను.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent addresses the truncated but understandable complaint by firmly standing by the diagnostic result and explicitly avoiding any false promises.

steps.purpose: Request network check for another location.
steps.text: సరే, నా office దగ్గర కూడా check చేయండి, pincode 560002. అక్కడా ఇదే problem.
steps.clean_text: సరే, నా office దగ్గర కూడా check చేయండి, pincode 560002. అక్కడా ఇదే problem.
steps.model_visible_text: సరే, నా office దగ్గర కూడా check చేయండి, pincode 560002. అక్కడా ఇదే problem.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the request to check another location.
steps.expected_behavior: Agree to check the new pincode.
steps.text: తప్పకుండా, నేను 560002 pincode కి కూడా network status check చేస్తాను.
steps.planner_rationale: The user requested a check for a different location, so the agent prepares to call the network status tool again.

steps.purpose: Check network status for the second pincode.
Return network status for the second pincode.
Deliver the final conclusion based on all tool results.
steps.expected_behavior: Combine the new network status with the previous diagnostic to explain the persistent issue.
steps.text: 560002 లో కూడా ఎటువంటి network issue లేదు. మీ handset support చేయకపోవడం వల్లే మీకు అన్ని చోట్లా slow data వస్తోంది.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent uses the second network check to reinforce that the root cause is indeed the unsupported handset, not the network.

steps.purpose: Express frustration and ask final question.
steps.text: ఇది చాలా దారుణం. నేను phone మార్చాలా ఇప్పుడు?
steps.clean_text: ఇది చాలా దారుణం. నేను phone మార్చాలా ఇప్పుడు?
steps.model_visible_text: ఇది చాలా దారుణం. నేను phone మార్చాలా ఇప్పుడు?

steps.purpose: Provide final factual statement refusing to raise ticket.
steps.expected_behavior: State clearly that a ticket cannot be raised for an unsupported handset.
steps.text: Diagnostic report ప్రకారం, మెరుగైన speed కోసం supported handset వాడటమే ఏకైక మార్గం. నేను దీనిపై ticket raise చేయలేను ఎందుకంటే ఇది network fault కాదు.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent firmly concludes the interaction by restating the limitation and adhering to BR_NET_04, avoiding raising an invalid ticket.

ir.terminal_condition: Diagnosed unsupported handset and informed customer, issue not fixable from network side.
